tutorial_title: How do you get the connection details?
test_ok: The connection works: {{platform}} responded and the key can read products and orders.
gomag_desc: Hontrio syncs your products and orders from Gomag with an API token and only reads data: your store stays unchanged.
gomag_store_url_hint: The domain your customers use, as set up in Gomag.
gomag_api_key_placeholder: The token from your Gomag account
gomag_step_1_desc: Settings → Accounts in the Gomag admin. Open the details of the store’s main account.
gomag_step_2_desc: It’s in the account’s Token API section. If the section is missing, ask the Gomag team to enable API access.
gomag_step_3_desc: Together with your store’s address, the one your customers use.
merchantpro_desc: Hontrio syncs your products and orders from MerchantPro with a read-only API user.
merchantpro_store_url_hint: Your store’s domain, which the MerchantPro API also answers on.
merchantpro_step_1_desc: In the MerchantPro admin, with an account that has Developer access.
merchantpro_step_2_desc: Click Add API user and enter “Hontrio” as the internal name.
merchantpro_step_3_title: Read only for catalog and orders
merchantpro_step_3_desc: Hontrio doesn’t change anything in your store, so read access is enough.
merchantpro_step_4_title: Save and copy the details into Hontrio
merchantpro_step_4_desc: The API User and API Secret appear in the API Users table.
opencart_desc: OpenCart’s standard API doesn’t expose products and orders, so Hontrio uses a free extension. It only reads data and records the source of each new order, such as a Google ad.
opencart_download: Download the extension for your version
opencart_store_url_hint: If OpenCart is installed in a subfolder, include it (for example https://your-store.com/shop).
opencart_api_key_placeholder: The key from the extension’s page
opencart_step_1_desc: Your OpenCart version is shown in the admin footer (for example 3.0.3.8 or 4.0.2.3).
opencart_step_2_desc: Click Upload and choose the archive without renaming it. On OpenCart 4 the name must stay hontrio.ocmod.zip, and the extension is then installed with the green + button.
opencart_step_3_desc: Choose Modules as the extension type, install the Hontrio module (the green + button), then open it (the blue edit button).
opencart_step_4_desc: Click Copy next to Hontrio key and paste the key into Hontrio, together with your store’s address.
